## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run Falcon3 1B Instruct (Q4_K_M, needs ~1.1 GB, from [huggingface.co/tiiuae](https://huggingface.co/tiiuae/Falcon3-1B-Instruct-GGUF/tree/fc404df7cfbd32eaefbcbeb2079aba684e894d39))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf tiiuae/Falcon3-1B-Instruct-GGUF:q4_k_m
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf tiiuae/Falcon3-1B-Instruct-GGUF:q4_k_m
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (~1.8 GB) `llama cli -hf tiiuae/Falcon3-1B-Instruct-GGUF:q8_0`

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run Falcon3 1B Instruct (Q4_K_M, needs ~1.1 GB, from [huggingface.co/tiiuae](https://huggingface.co/tiiuae/Falcon3-1B-Instruct-GGUF/tree/fc404df7cfbd32eaefbcbeb2079aba684e894d39))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/tiiuae/Falcon3-1B-Instruct-GGUF@q4_k_m -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

Other versions: Q8_0 (~1.8 GB) `lms get https://huggingface.co/tiiuae/Falcon3-1B-Instruct-GGUF@q8_0 -y` · 4bit (~0.9 GB, Mac only) `lms get https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Falcon3-1B-Instruct-4bit -y` · 8bit (~1.8 GB, Mac only) `lms get https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Falcon3-1B-Instruct-8bit -y`

### Ollama

1. Install Ollama. [Download it (macOS / Windows)](https://ollama.com/download)
   
   ```sh
   # Linux
   curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
   ```

2. Run Falcon3 1B Instruct (Q4_K_M, needs ~1.5 GB, from [ollama.com](https://ollama.com/library/falcon3/tags))
   
   ```sh
   ollama run falcon3:1b-instruct-q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (~2.5 GB) `ollama run falcon3:1b-instruct-q8_0`

### MLX (Mac)

1. Install MLX (Mac). Apple silicon Macs only, text only.
   
   ```sh
   # with uv
   uv tool install mlx-lm
   # or
   pip install mlx-lm
   ```

2. Run Falcon3 1B Instruct (4bit, needs ~0.9 GB, Mac only, from [huggingface.co/mlx-community](https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Falcon3-1B-Instruct-4bit/tree/56ed268fcb174dd7ce223eb86202460e2e5032ce))
   
   ```sh
   mlx_lm.chat --model mlx-community/Falcon3-1B-Instruct-4bit
   ```

3. Or start an OpenAI-compatible server at http://localhost:8080/v1
   
   ```sh
   mlx_lm.server --model mlx-community/Falcon3-1B-Instruct-4bit
   ```

Other versions: 8bit (~1.8 GB, Mac only) `mlx_lm.chat --model mlx-community/Falcon3-1B-Instruct-8bit`

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/tiiuae](https://huggingface.co/tiiuae/Falcon3-1B-Instruct)
